_comment: 六 Agent 流水线配置。Paper only：无钱包、无签名、无真实订单。

judge._note: LLM 只研判通过 veto 的候选，只重排不放行；无 key 或失败自动降级为规则分。OpenAI 兼容，换服务商只改 base_url/model/api_key_env。
judge.weight_note: 0.4 was given before any calibration existed. First calibration data (2026-10-27 16:00, n=27/30/20 across 15m/30m/60m) shows NO monotonic separation: 15m Spearman -0.17 (inverted), 30m +0.25 with the MIDDLE bucket best, 60m indistinguishable. Until the calibration shows a monotonic positive rank correlation across three consecutive days, the opinion is a tiebreaker at most. Restore 0.4 only on that evidence, not on hope.

tiers._note: 软门槛不再一票否决：只过硬否决的候选进 probe 池，JUDGE 打分 ≥55 才用 0 试探仓。硬否决（权限/集中度/崩塌/洗量）永不动。

sizing._note: JUDGE 分数=结构健康度（非涨幅预测）。>=80 冲 1.5x；60-80 标准 1x；40-60 稳 0.4x；<40 不开。单笔不超过账本 15%。阈值可由 calibration 分桶调整。
